info.name: CraftLane (ClappN) - Complete API Collection
info.description:
Complete Postman collection for CraftLane e-commerce platform API. Includes 397+ endpoints across 22 categories with authentication, request/response examples, and tests.

**How to Use:**
1. Import this file in Postman
2. Set environment variables (see Variables tab)
3. Get JWT token from Login endpoint
4. Use token in subsequent requests

**Base URL:** {{base_url}}
**JWT Token:** {{jwt_token}}
